title: Ancient DNA Extraction from Chunk Samples
author: Marcel Keller
materials: Place all reagents (except proteinase K) and consumables in the hood and UV while weighing.

steps.title: Set up decontamination station
steps.instruction: Arrange 4 disposable 100 mL beakers and add the following aliquots: 6 % NaOCl (bleach) – two beakers, Milli‑Q water – one beaker, 70 % ethanol – one beaker.

steps.title: Decontaminate tweezers
steps.instruction: Soak tweezers in 6 % bleach for 5 minutes, then rinse briefly with Milli‑Q water followed by a rinse with 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Clean bench and hood
steps.instruction: Wipe the table bench surface with DNA Exitus and dry it. Turn the hood on to full power and open the glass door.

steps.title: Transfer dried samples
steps.instruction: If samples have been dried in the hood after decontamination, move each dry sample from the hood to the bench and place a fresh sheet of aluminum foil on the bench.

steps.title: Clean hood surface and reagents
steps.instruction: Wipe the interior hood surfaces with DNA Exitus, lay a new sheet of aluminum foil inside the hood, and also wipe all reagents with DNA Exitus.

steps.title: Weigh samples
steps.instruction: Tare the balance with a small weighing boat labeled with the sample number. Using tweezers, place the tooth/petrous core into the boat, record its weight, and change gloves after weighing.

steps.title: Prepare EDTA and Proteinase K solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) and a Proteinase K stock at 18.18 mg mL⁻¹. Calculate volumes for each sample: EDTA = 2 mL per 100 mg sample (weight ÷ 50); Proteinase K = 50 µL per 100 mg sample (weight ÷ 2); total tube volume = 5 mL per 100 mg (e.g., 100 mg → 2 mL EDTA, 50 µL PK, 5 mL tube; 300 mg → 6 mL EDTA, 150 µL PK, 15 mL tube). If a Proteinase K solution is needed, dissolve 100 mg powder in 5.5 mL PCR‑clean water, shake until dissolved, let sit, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Label extraction tubes
steps.instruction: Label each tube with: Top side label, Project ID (PROJ), Sample ID (e.g., ABC001A), Extraction # 1, your initials (YZ), date (DD/MM/YYYY), and content description (P Pellet).

steps.title: Add EDTA to tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette the calculated volume of 0.5 M EDTA into each extraction tube. The same tip may be reused provided it does not contact the filter or any surfaces.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K to tubes
steps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of Proteinase K to each tube, pipette‑mix thoroughly, and use a fresh tip for each tube.

steps.title: Add samples to tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the weighed tooth/petrous core into its corresponding extraction tube.

steps.title: Seal and wrap tubes
steps.instruction: Tightly close each tube lid to prevent leakage, wipe the exterior with DNA Exitus, and seal the tube with Parafilm.

steps.title: Incubate on nutating mixer
steps.instruction: Place the sealed tubes on a nutating mixer set to 24 rpm at room temperature for 3 days (72 hours). Continue with the downstream purification protocol after this incubation.
